attacks.claim: The sign form is a state-changing POST to /p/{slug}/sign, but the template contains no CSRF token field, and the artifact does not mention CSRF protection anywhere. A cross-site page could submit signatures on a signer's behalf if the endpoint does not enforce its own anti-forgery check.
attacks.evidence: <form class="sign-form" action="/p/{{ petition.slug }}/sign" method="post" novalidate> ... ABSENT: no csrf token input or anti-CSRF control described
